title: The Cutting Edge: Week of July 26th
body:
**Highlights**
- The long awaiting [community film update](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1473-community-film-update-thread) is out!
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [latest release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.3.3) to proceed further with the ERUP-4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Community members who are interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members who are interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
- Commonwealth launched a [weekly roundup newsletter](https://twitter.com/hicommonwealth/status/1419757736661852164?s=20) that will cover all major events related to governance & DAOs across the whole crypto ecosystem.
- Edgeware Treasury born privacy-focused project [Webb Protocol delivered grants to the Web3 Foundation and Harmony Protocol](https://twitter.com/webbprotocol/status/1421528678119493633?s=20) nurturing Edgeware’s stance of ‘A Complementor rather than a Competitor’.


**Governance**
- Upcoming Proposals: Continuation of OnFinality's public nodes offering and New-Futures


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in,[ take a look.](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal)
